verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects is a planning and tracking tool (tables, boards, roadmaps, custom fields, workflows), not a code-execution environment or coding agent, so having an agent auto-detect and install toolchains is outside its category. The mention of assigning issues to Copilot shows delegation from Issues, but nothing in the pack shows Projects itself detecting or installing toolchains or dependencies, so the exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have a coding agent auto-detect and install the toolchains and dependencies it needs for a task
